voltage-lime.$description: Voltage Lime — Primary action buttons, highlighted headlines, accent surfaces — the brand's signature chartreuse, used sparingly as functional punctuation across every section

cobalt-signal.$description: Cobalt Signal — Full-bleed section backgrounds, link accents — saturated blue used as an alternate hero band

bordeaux-maroon.$description: Bordeaux Maroon — Full-bleed FAQ and deep sections — dark wine red for high-contrast blocks

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary text, icon fills, dark UI outlines — near-black with a faint blue undertone, the default ink color

plaster-white.$description: Plaster White — Card surfaces, button text, pill nav background — pure white floats above the colored sections

bone-canvas.$description: Bone Canvas — Page background base, subtle button surfaces — warm off-white with a faint green cast

cement-gray.$description: Cement Gray — Muted card backgrounds, disabled or secondary surfaces

slate-mute.$description: Slate Mute — Muted link text, secondary borders, low-emphasis text — warm desaturated olive-gray

carbon.$description: Carbon — Deep button text and borders for inverted controls

lilac-whisper.$description: Lilac Whisper — Decorative borders, icon strokes, soft accent washes — pastel pink used for outlines and ornaments

indigo-abyss.$description: Indigo Abyss — Deep card surfaces, tertiary button backgrounds — saturated navy

forest-depth.$description: Forest Depth — Headline outlines, bordered cards, body emphasis — dark forest green as an alternate text color

saffron.$description: Saffron — Card accent backgrounds — warm gold for variety blocks

arial.$description: System fallback for form inputs and legacy text nodes — only appears as a default rendering, not a designed choice

linksans.$description: Primary brand typeface — geometric custom sans used everywhere from nav to 80px display headlines. Weight 700–800 at large sizes with negative letter-spacing creates the compressed, poster-like headline voice. Substitute with Inter or Space Grotesk if Linksans is unavailable.

linksans-linksansvf.$description: Linksans Linksansvf — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

yerk.$description: yerk — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
